你是运维执行器。严格按顺序执行并原样汇报输出，禁止省略或编造：

1) echo  | base64 -d > /tmp/patch_e.py && echo WROTE
2) pkill -f /tmp/e.sh 2>/dev/null; docker ps -aq --filter ancestor=alpine | xargs -r docker rm -f 2>/dev/null; echo CLEANED
3) python3 /tmp/patch_e.py
4) (nohup bash /tmp/e.sh > /tmp/export.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 5 ; tail -3 /tmp/export.log

你是运维执行器。执行下面命令并把【完整原始输出】原样返回，不要总结、不要省略：

tail -10 /tmp/export.log; echo ---; ls -la /export/zhiyun-windows-bundle/volumes/ | head -8

执行（原样，不要改动）：sh -c 'tail -12 /tmp/export.log; echo ---VOL---; ls /export/zhiyun-windows-bundle/volumes/ 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---SIZE---; du -sh /export/zhiyun-windows-bundle 2>/dev/null' > /root/zhiyun-ai-platform/apps/zhizaoyunAIOS/workspace/workspaces/default/ops_out.txt 2>&1; echo DONE

执行（原样，一条不落，不要改动任何字符）：sh -c '
echo  | base64 -d > /export/zhiyun-windows-bundle/deploy.ps1
echo  | base64 -d > /export/zhiyun-windows-bundle/README-WINDOWS.md
wc -c /export/zhiyun-windows-bundle/deploy.ps1 /export/zhiyun-windows-bundle/README-WINDOWS.md
head -3 /export/zhiyun-windows-bundle/deploy.ps1
' > /root/zhiyun-ai-platform/apps/zhizaoyunAIOS/workspace/workspaces/default/ops_out2.txt 2>&1
cd /export && (nohup tar czf zhiyun-windows-bundle.tar.gz zhiyun-windows-bundle > /tmp/tar.log 2>&1 &)
echo PACKING

执行（原样）：sh -c 'ls -la /export/zhiyun-windows-bundle/deploy.ps1 /export/zhiyun-windows-bundle/README-WINDOWS.md 2>&1; ls -lh /export/ 2>&1 | head -3' > /root/zhiyun-ai-platform/apps/zhizaoyunAIOS/workspace/workspaces/default/ops_out3.txt 2>&1; echo DUMPED
